column3: Domine, Dominus noster, quam admirabile est nomen tuum in universa terra!
O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is your name throughout the earth!
Viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum, quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum.
My eyes have seen your salvation, which you prepared in the sight of all peoples.
Ecce virgo concipiet, et pariet filium, et vocabitur nomen ejus Emmanuel.
See, the Virgin will conceive and bear a son, and he will be called Emmanuel.
Fecit mihi magna qui potens est: et sanctum nomen ejus.
The Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name.
Ave, Maria, gratia plena: Dominus tecum: benedicta tu in mulieribus, et benedictus fructus ventris tui.
Hail, Mary, full of grace. The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
Virga Jesse floruit: Virgo Deum et hominem genuit: pacem Deus reddidit, in se reconcilians ima summis.
The shoot of Jesse blossomed. The Virgin bore him who is God and man. God restored peace, reconciling in himself the things below with those above.
Diffusa est gratia in labiis tuis: propterea benedixit te Deus in æternum.
Grace is poured out upon your lips. Therefore God has blessed you for ever.
Rorate, cæli, desuper, et nubes pluant justum; aperiatur terra, et germinet Salvatorem.
Drop dew from above, you heavens. Let the clouds rain down the Just One. Let the earth open and bring forth the Savior.
Dico autem vobis amicis meis: Ne terreamini ab his qui vos persequuntur.
I say to you, my friends, do not be frightened by those who persecute you.
Clamaverunt justi, et Dominus exaudivit eos; et ex omnibus tribulationibus eorum liberavit eos.
The just cried out, and the Lord heard them and freed them from all their troubles.
In mortem tradimur propter Jesum: ut et vita Jesu manifestetur in carne nostra mortali.
We are handed over to death for Jesus’ sake so that the life of Jesus too may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
Pretiosa in conspectu Domini mors sanctorum ejus. Alleluja.
Precious in the Lord’s sight is the death of his holy ones, alleluia.
Signum magnum apparuit in cælo: mulier amicta sole, et luna sub pedibus ejus, et in capite ejus corona stellarum duodecim.
A great sign appeared in heaven, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and a crown of twelve stars upon her head.
Beatam me dicent omnes generationes, quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est.
All generations will call me blessed, for the Mighty One has done great things for me.
Astitit regina a dextris tuis in vestitu deaurato, circumdata varietate.
The queen stood at your right hand in a gold-embroidered garment, arrayed in many colors.
Communicantes Christi passionibus gaudete, ut et in revelatione gloriæ ejus gaudeatis exsultantes.
Rejoice as you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that when his glory is revealed you may also rejoice and exult.
Ecce concipies in utero, et paries filium, et vocabis nomen ejus Jesum.
See, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you will name him Jesus.
In fide vivo Filii Dei, qui dilexit me, et tradidit semetipsum pro me.
I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
Annuntiate inter gentes gloriam ejus; in omnibus populis mirabilia ejus. Quoniam magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis.
Proclaim his glory among the nations and his wonders among all peoples, for the Lord is great and worthy of the highest praise.
Panem cæli dedit eis. Panem angelorum manducavit homo.
He gave them bread from heaven. A human being ate the bread of angels.
Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, quia visitavit, et fecit redemptionem plebis suæ.
Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited his people and brought them redemption.
Lex veritatis fuit in ore ejus, et iniquitas non est inventa in labiis ejus: in pace et in æquitate ambulavit mecum, et multos avertit ab iniquitate.
The law of truth was in his mouth, and no injustice was found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness and turned many away from wrongdoing.
Fidelis servus et prudens, quem constituit dominus super familiam suam: ut det illis in tempore tritici mensuram.
A faithful and prudent servant, whom the Lord placed over his household to give them their measure of wheat in due season.
In nomine Jesu omne genu flectatur cælestium, terrestrium et infernorum, et omnis lingua confiteatur, quia Dominus Jesus Christus in gloria est Dei Patris.
At the name of Jesus let every knee bend, of those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. Let every tongue confess that the Lord Jesus Christ is in the glory of God the Father.
Spiritus Domini super me: propter quod unxit me, evangelizare pauperibus misit me, sanare contritos corde.
The Spirit of the Lord is upon me. For this he anointed me and sent me to bring good news to the poor and to heal the brokenhearted.
Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum. Quia satiavit animam inanem, et animam esurientem satiavit bonis.
Let them give thanks to the Lord for his mercies and for his wonders toward the children of earth, for he filled the empty soul and satisfied the hungry soul with good things.
Beati pauperes spiritu: quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum, ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus. Sitivit anima mea ad Deum fortem, vivum.
As the deer longs for flowing streams, so my soul longs for you, O God. My soul thirsts for the living, mighty God.
Misericordias Domini in æternum cantabo; in generationem et generationem annuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo.
I will sing of the Lord’s mercies for ever. From generation to generation my mouth will proclaim your faithfulness.
Quam pulchri super montes pedes annuntiantis et prædicantis pacem; annuntiantis bonum, prædicantis salutem!
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the one who brings tidings and proclaims peace, who brings good news and proclaims salvation!
Beati mundo corde: quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt. Beati pacifici: quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur. Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter justitiam: quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.

Blessed are the pure of heart, for they will see God. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God. Blessed are those who suffer persecution for the sake of justice, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter justitiam: quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.
Blessed are those who suffer persecution for the sake of justice, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
Mihi autem absit gloriari, nisi in cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi: per quem mihi mundus crucifixus est, et ego mundo.
As for me, may I boast only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.
Lapidabant Stephanum invocantem, et dicentem: Domine Jesu, suscipe spiritum meum.
They were stoning Stephen as he called out, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
Dominus dabit benignitatem, et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
The Lord will give what is good, and our land will yield its fruit.
Ecce Dominus veniet, et omnes sancti ejus cum eo: et erit in die illa lux magna.
See, the Lord will come, and all his holy ones with him. On that day there will be a great light.
Vocabunt nomen ejus Emmanuel, quod est interpretatum Nobiscum Deus.
They will call him Emmanuel, which means “God with us.”
Beata, quæ credidisti, quoniam perficientur ea, quæ dicta sunt tibi a Domino.
Blessed are you who believed, for the things the Lord spoke to you will be fulfilled.
Dominus dixit ad me: Filius meus es tu; ego hodie genui te.
The Lord said to me, “You are my Son. Today I have begotten you.”
De plenitudine ejus nos omnes accepimus, et gratiam pro gratia.
From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.
Non in solo pane vivit homo, sed in omni verbo, quod procedit de ore Dei.
A human being lives by more than bread alone, by every word that comes from the mouth of God.
Scapulis suis obumbrabit tibi Dominus, et sub pennis ejus sperabis.
The Lord will shelter you with his pinions, and beneath his wings you will put your hope.
Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi bene complacui: ipsum audite.
This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.
Oportet te, fili, gaudere, quia frater tuus mortuus fuerat, et revixit: perierat, et inventus est.
My son, you ought to rejoice, for this brother of yours was dead and has come back to life. He was lost and has been found.
Illumina oculos meos, ne umquam obdormiam in morte; nequando dicat inimicus meus: Prævalui adversus eum.
Give light to my eyes lest I ever sleep in death, lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him.”
Narrabo omnia mirabilia tua. Lætabor et exsultabo in te; psallam nomini tuo, Altissime.
I will recount all your wonders. I will rejoice and exult in you and sing praise to your name, Most High.
Filius hominis non venit ministrari, sed ministrare, et dare animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
The Son of Man came to serve and to give his life as a ransom for many, rather than to be served.
Beati immaculati in via, qui ambulant in lege Domini.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord.
Miserator et misericors Dominus: patiens, et multum misericors. Suavis Dominus universis, et miserationes ejus super omnia opera ejus.
The Lord is compassionate and merciful, patient and rich in mercy. The Lord is good to all, and his mercies are over all his works.
Concupiscit, et deficit anima mea in atria Domini; cor meum et caro mea exsultaverunt in Deum vivum.
My soul yearns and grows faint for the courts of the Lord. My heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.
Domine, quis habitabit in tabernaculo tuo? aut quis requiescet in monte sancto tuo? Qui ingreditur sine macula, et operatur justitiam.
Lord, who will dwell in your tent? Who will rest on your holy mountain? The one who walks blamelessly and does what is right.
Gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum, et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia.
Guide my steps according to your word, and let no injustice have dominion over me.
Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis. Utinam dirigantur viæ meæ ad custodiendas justificationes tuas.
You have commanded that your commandments be kept diligently. May my paths be guided toward keeping your statutes.
Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones ejus. Qui propitiatur omnibus iniquitatibus tuis.
Bless the Lord, my soul, and never forget all his benefits. He forgives all your iniquities.
Dominus regit me, et nihil mihi deerit: in loco pascuæ, ibi me collocavit. Super aquam refectionis educavit me.
The Lord is my shepherd, and I shall lack nothing. He set me in a place of pasture and led me beside refreshing water.
Ego vero orationem meam ad te, Domine; tempus beneplaciti, Deus. In multitudine misericordiæ tuæ, exaudi me in veritate salutis tuæ.
But I offer my prayer to you, Lord, at a time of your favor, O God. In your abundant mercy hear me, faithful in your saving help.
Non avertas faciem tuam a me: in quacumque die tribulor, inclina ad me aurem tuam; in quacumque die invocavero te, velociter exaudi me.
Do not turn your face away from me. On whatever day I am in trouble, incline your ear to me. On whatever day I call to you, hear me quickly.
Repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto, loquentes magnalia Dei, alleluja.
All were filled with the Holy Spirit, proclaiming the mighty deeds of God, alleluia.
Salvos nos fac, Domine Deus noster, et congrega nos de nationibus: ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, et gloriemur in laude tua.
Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, so that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
Beati pauperes spiritu: quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum. Beati mites: quoniam ipsi possidebunt terram.
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs. Blessed are the meek, for they will possess the earth.
Beati qui lugent: quoniam ipsi consolabuntur. Beati qui esuriunt et sitiunt justitiam: quoniam ipsi saturabuntur.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted. Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for justice, for they will be satisfied.
Manducaverunt, et saturati sunt nimis, et desiderium eorum attulit eis Dominus: non sunt fraudati a desiderio suo.
They ate and were filled to the full. The Lord brought them what they desired. They were not deprived of their desire.
Factus est Dominus protector meus. Et eduxit me in latitudinem; salvum me fecit, quoniam voluit me.
The Lord became my protector and led me out into the open. He saved me because he delighted in me.
Cantabo Domino qui bona tribuit mihi; et psallam nomini Domini altissimi.
I will sing to the Lord, who has dealt kindly with me, and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
Dominus firmamentum meum, et refugium meum, et liberator meus. Deus meus adjutor meus.
The Lord is my stronghold, my refuge and my deliverer. My God is my helper.
Deus caritas est: et qui manet in caritate, in Deo manet, et Deus in eo.
God is love, and whoever remains in love remains in God, and God in that person.
Omnes gentes, plaudite manibus; jubilate Deo in voce exsultationis.
All nations, clap your hands. Cry out to God with a voice of joy.
Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus; beatus vir qui sperat in eo.
Taste and see how good the Lord is. Blessed is the one who hopes in him.
Memoriam fecit mirabilium suorum, misericors et miserator Dominus. Escam dedit timentibus se.
The Lord, merciful and compassionate, has made a memorial of his wonders. He has given food to those who fear him.
Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones ejus.
Bless the Lord, my soul, and never forget all his benefits.
Beati misericordes: quoniam ipsi misericordiam consequentur. Beati mundo corde: quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt.
Blessed are the merciful, for they will receive mercy. Blessed are the pure of heart, for they will see God.
Protector noster, aspice, Deus, et respice in faciem christi tui. Quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia.
Look, O God, our protector, and see the face of your anointed one, for one day in your courts is better than thousands.
Apud Dominum misericordia, et copiosa apud eum redemptio.
With the Lord there is mercy, and with him there is abundant redemption.
Beati pacifici: quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur. Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter justitiam: quoniam ipsorum est regnum cælorum.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God. Blessed are those who suffer persecution for the sake of justice, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum, animæ quærenti illum.
The Lord is good to those who hope in him, to the soul that seeks him.
Lætabimur in salutari tuo; et in nomine Dei nostri magnificabimur.
We will rejoice in your saving help, and in the name of our God we will be exalted.
Mihi autem adhærere Deo bonum est; ponere in Domino Deo spem meam.
As for me, it is good to cling to God and put my hope in the Lord God.
Quoniam autem estis filii, misit Deus Spiritum Filii sui in corda vestra, clamantem: Abba, Pater.
Because you are his children, God sent the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father.”
Exsultabit cor meum in salutari tuo. Cantabo Domino qui bona tribuit mihi.
My heart will exult in your saving help. I will sing to the Lord, who has dealt kindly with me.
